title: Listening Drill — Pottery taster
description: Booking dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Pottery taster
sections.transcript:
CALLER: Hello. I'd like to book a pottery taster session. I saw an older notice saying that bookings opened on Monday morning. Is that still right?

ADVISER: That notice is out of date. Bookings open on Tuesday this time. If you collect your booking pack in person, go to the studio office. The reception desk in the main building won't have the packs.

CALLER: How much is the booking? I can pay online if that saves time.

ADVISER: The total is twenty pounds. Pay once you've checked the date. Then contact Nina if you haven't received confirmation within two working days.

CALLER: Thanks. Is there anything else I should know before I arrive?

ADVISER: One practical detail: aprons are provided.
